artifact: M9 solver-shaped connected contact water V7 three-layer isolated review
summary: V7 implements the multi-layer architecture requested by the rejected V6 review without changing simulation authority: a solver-sampled horizontal attachment, aerated crest, and two-lobe breakup layer render as three noncolliding procedural-mesh sections with 296 live triangles. Initial native captures showed no readable volume. A temporary vertex-color diagnostic proved that the geometry was displaced behind the contact boulder because the dominant contact vector points from the raft toward the compressed tube and obstacle, not toward the exposed escape face. Reversing that presentation-only direction moved all three layers to the raft-rock pin. The real material then exposed a tall translucent sail. A final bounded flattening and stronger independently controlled foam budgets reduced the height but still rendered a smooth geometric sheet rather than irregular turbulent water. The diagnostic code path was removed. The V7 architecture remains opt-in and review-only, production remains selected and byte-identical, and promotion is rejected.
